note: THE LANE IS INVISIBLE TO census-run.sh status, WHICH REPORTS no-heavy-run WHILE A LANE JOB HOLDS 39 OF 40 CORES. Observed live 2026-08-16T00:16Z during lane job heavy-1e856f054bb5: claim file present and correct, holder pid 667050 alive, loadavg 32.37 — and hornvale lab claim-status still printed the no-heavy-run line. CAUSE: parse_claim, windows/lab/src/census_claim.rs:100-129, requires ALL EIGHT fields via the try operator: pid host user started goldens label ref cmdline. census-run.sh, heavy-run.sh and census_claim.rs:86 each write all 8. scripts/lane-run.sh writes only 7 — it omits goldens and cmdline, and adds a job key nothing parses. So parse_claim returns None, live_holder_at returns None, and status_line returns the no-heavy-run string for the ENTIRE duration of EVERY lane job: stage gate, campaign gate, heavy, census, seam-guard. The flock is FINE and serialisation is unaffected; this is a false all-clear in the OBSERVABILITY path — on the exact command root CLAUDE.md tells you to run before consuming the box, and on make heavy-status, which CLAUDE.md calls almost always the question you mean. Latent since The Staff, two days. cli/tests/claim_shape.rs does NOT cover it: despite the name it lints seed-loop claim tags. FIX: two echo lines in lane-run.sh, plus a test that a lane-written claim round-trips through parse_claim. The Sluice is fixing it as Task 0 because its own plan used that vacuous gate as a quiet-box check.
